channel.description: FEMA disbursed $244.5 million for critical infrastructure across the AAA, LUMA vegetation management, public housing, and an Adjuntas road project, part of $1.3 billion COR3 has released since January — a solid federal-funding signal. Oilfield technology firm Flotek Industries reportedly upgraded its outlook on a new Puerto Rico deal, though details remain unconfirmed. On the risk side, a UPR/Banco Popular/DDEC-backed study found early-stage entrepreneurship fell sharply (24.3% to 15.6%) despite better business survival rates, and an opinion analysis flagged a weakening credit union financial stability index. Overall a moderate week: real federal infrastructure dollars landing, but softer signals on entrepreneurship and cooperative-sector stability.
